fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM85,400. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003077/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: i. Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR pass in STPM or equivalent with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects and credit in: a) Additional Mathematics; OR b) Mathematics and any one of the Science, Technology or Engineering subjects. Note: Students under i b) must take and pass Mathematics reinforcement subjects before proceeding to relevant core courses unless exempted by prior qualifications. ii. Pass STPM in Science stream or equivalent with minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in one Mathematics and one Science/ICT subject; OR iii. Diploma in Computer Science / Software Engineering / IT / Information Systems or equivalent with minimum CGPA of 2.50; OR iv. Any other Diploma in science and technology with minimum CGPA of 2.50.
